text:
Samira: Heads-up: AuroraX reserved pool goes live tonight 23:45 UTC. Config: 10xH100, target steady 680k tpm, occasional promos up to 900k for ~5-10m. Need a tight canary, cost note for renewal, and an ops rollback contact.
Owen: Ack. Proposed ramp: 15m shadow, 15m at 25%, 30m at 60%, then full for 3h. Recommend temp quota bump to 800k for 6h.
Priyanka: From runtime: autoscaler default is 70% util. For these short bursts enable rapid scale-out (25s) and conservative scale-in (5m). Also enable KV pre-warm for top 10 endpoints and increase KV prefetch parallelism.
Luis: AuroraX asks: p99 < 140ms for short prompts and zero dropped requests. They request automatic fallback to hosted-quantized when Dedicated latency exceeds threshold AND a manual rollback contact.
Samira: Fallback rule idea: if p99 >220ms for 3m AND queue depth >250 for 2m -> shift 30% of new requests to hosted-quant-nl (same model quantized) and page oncall. Manual approval needed before raising to 60%.
OncallBot: Maintenance note: kernel patch scheduled 02:15 UTC. Recommend move to 05:00 to avoid overlap with the 6h promo.
Owen: I'll reschedule to 05:00. Patch window updated.
Priyanka: Loadtest plan: replay prod traces using vegeta and a separate burst script for promo peaks. Commands: `vegeta attack -rate=15000 -duration=10m | vegeta report` and burst: `k6 run --vus 1200 --duration 8m scripts/aurora-burst.js`
AuroraX-Eng: AuroraX: We'll need a short enablement walkthrough after soak for our infra and SRE teams. Prefer 11am PT tomorrow.
Samira: Scheduling 11am PT enablement. Also adding a renewal note: if sustained >75% quota for 14 days we open expansion discussion and include a cost projection.
Priyanka: Deploying diagnostic header `x-rw-diagnose: aurorax-10h` so traces separate model vs routing time. Also enabling KV pre-warm now.
Owen: Canary start: shadow 15m -> logs: "shadow 15m | rps ~11200 | p99 128ms | errors 0"
Priyanka: 25% stage: p99 137ms, GPU util 52%, KV hit 71%. All good.
Luis: Observed a hot key pattern hitting shard-12 on the second stage causing queue jitter. Autoscaler added +1 GPU at 00:14 and rebalanced.
Owen: 60% stage: avg rps ~41000, p99 159ms, GPU util 77%, KV hit 68%. Small tail increase but within SLO.
AuroraX-Eng: AuroraX: We're happy so far. Please proceed to full. Also can you include an hourly cost snapshot?
Samira: Will include cost snapshots every hour to the thread and to the post-run deck.
Priyanka: Burst test started at 01:40 UTC with k6. Burst log: "VU 1200 | iterations 57600 | errors 0 | peak p99 202ms"
Luis: At burst peak we saw queue depth spike on shard-12 again. Scaling triggered +2 GPUs at 01:43 UTC; one GPU pre-warm reduced latency quickly.
OncallBot: Alert: fallback rule evaluated at 01:44 UTC -> condition met briefly (queue depth >250 for 2m) but p99 dropped under threshold after scale. No route cut executed.
Samira: Good catch. Because scaling absorbed the load we didn't hit fallback. Action: investigate shard-12 hashing to spread hot keys better.
Owen: Post-run numbers: soak 4h total, peak scaled to 12 GPUs, avg p99 151ms, peak p99 210ms during short burst, KV hit average 70%. No customer-visible errors.
AuroraX-Eng: AuroraX: Thanks team. Performance ok. We'll review the cost deck before renewal meeting.
Samira: Follow-ups: (1) ticket RTE-1302 hot-shard mitigation (investigate shard-12), (2) CS-4908 renewal + cost deck, (3) adjust default autoscale config recommendation for promo-heavy accounts (lower scale-out to 30s).
Priyanka: I'll prepare the runbook edit with k6/vegeta commands, canary stages, and the diagnostic header.
Luis: I'll take RTE-1302 and add traces to the ticket.
OncallBot: Exported metrics -> /exports/aurorax/3610002222, summary sent to #account-health.
Samira: Great work team 44f Closing thread once tickets created.
